description: This file implements backend logic for the OpenShell sandbox environment, including sandbox creation, management, remote command execution, and workspace synchronization, with support for 'mirror' and 'remote' modes.

classes.name: OpenShellSandboxBackendImpl
classes.description: Implementation class managing sandbox lifecycle, command execution, and workspace synchronization for OpenShell backend.

methods.name: buildOpenShellSshExecEnv
methods.description: Creates a sanitized environment variables object for SSH execution.

methods.name: createOpenShellSandboxBackendFactory
methods.description: Factory function to create sandbox backend instances.

methods.name: createOpenShellSandboxBackendManager
methods.description: Creates a manager for handling runtime descriptions and removal of sandbox instances.

methods.name: asHandle
methods.description: Returns a handle object representing the sandbox backend with methods for command execution and workspace sync.

methods.name: prepareExec
methods.description: Prepares the environment for executing a command, including ensuring sandbox existence and workspace sync.

methods.name: finalizeExec
methods.description: Finalizes command execution, optionally syncing workspace from remote.

methods.name: runRemoteShellScript
methods.description: Runs a remote shell script within the sandbox environment.

methods.name: syncLocalPathToRemote
methods.description: Uploads a local path to the remote sandbox workspace.

methods.name: ensureSandboxExists
methods.description: Ensures the sandbox exists, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: syncWorkspaceToRemote
methods.description: Syncs local workspace contents to the remote sandbox.

methods.name: syncWorkspaceFromRemote
methods.description: Downloads remote workspace contents to local directory.

methods.name: uploadPathToRemote
methods.description: Uploads a directory or file to the remote sandbox.
